summary: Ericsson filed a Form 6-K on August 3, 2026, announcing weekly share buybacks executed under a previously disclosed program from April 23, 2026, to March 31, 2027, with a maximum of SEK 15 billion. During July 27-31, 2026, it repurchased 3.5 million Class B shares at an average SEK 94.6474 per share, totaling SEK 331 million, via Goldman Sachs on Nasdaq Stockholm. Post-repurchase, treasury stock is 91.2 million shares. The board intends to propose cancellation of repurchased shares (except for incentive programs) at the 2027 AGM. This is a routine ongoing capital return update, not a tender offer.
